connector.name: MCP Server by pdfgate.com
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the PDFGate API. Generate PDFs, manage documents and handle e-signatures.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.pdfgate, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PDFGATE_API_KEY
env.description: Your PDFGate API key (starts with live_ for production or test_ for sandbox)

env.name: PDFGATE_WEBHOOK_PORT
env.description: Port for the local webhook listener (default: 3599)
